config_writes.rule: Read the project's current `.github/scrum/config.yml` before writing to it. Update only the keys explicitly elicited from the human. Preserve everything else, structure included.
Never write or ask the human for `backends.github.auth.token`. It resolves from `$GITHUB_TOKEN` or an equivalent environment reference, never a literal value in config.

`backends.github.field_mapping`, `backends.github.status_display`, `backends.github.priority_display`, and `backends.github.type_mapping` map canonical Scrum vocabulary to exact GitHub Projects field and option names. Propose these from the board's own available fields; confirm every mapping with the human before writing - names are case-sensitive, and a wrong mapping breaks option resolution silently rather than erroring.

After writing to any of `field_mapping`, `status_display`, `priority_display`, or `type_mapping`: re-orient before continuing - these changes alter how live board options resolve. Metadata-only writes (`definition_of_ready`, `definition_of_done`, sprint length, team roster, `deadline_field`) don't require this.
Write `definition_of_ready` and `definition_of_done` as plain string lists, 3-5 items each.
